mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in unemployment, signals a positive supply shock that will boost productivity and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% m/m and UNRATE does not rise
failure_condition: SPX realizes negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where the positive supply shock signal is triggered.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, if accompanied by a simultaneous decline in payroll employment, signals a weakening labor market that will drag on consumer spending and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence (Conference Board index) rises > 2pts during the signal period, contradicting the negative labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals impending monetary tightening that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The yield curve steepens by > 20bps during the signal period, reversing the tightening impulse.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts, if accompanied by a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate, signal a positive demand shock that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 2% m/m and UNRATE declines
failure_condition: The housing starts series subsequently revises downward by > 5% in the following month's release, negating the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in the federal funds rate, signals a negative supply shock that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% m/m and FEDFUNDS does not rise
failure_condition: Real wages (average hourly earnings adjusted for CPI) rise during the signal period, contradicting the negative supply shock story.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production, if accompanied by a simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate, signals a negative supply shock that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% m/m and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp
failure_condition: The ISM manufacturing PMI rises above 50 during the signal period, contradicting the negative supply shock story.

mechanism_narrative: Rising real estate loans, if accompanied by a simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate, signal a positive demand shock that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 1% m/m and FEDFUNDS declines
failure_condition: The senior loan officer survey shows a tightening of lending standards during the signal period, negating the positive demand impulse.
